blocks.t: A. This kit contains the following parts.
2 MDST-10-22 MDS-TBL Leg Extension Support Bracket 2
3 DJURT-80-17 Hex Head Mach. Screw M8 X 20 (Black) 18
1) Lay the cabinet down for easier installation.
2) To install the new parts (ITEM #1), first remove the old leg assembly, then install the new parts (ITEM #1) into the cabinet.
3) Replace the old leg into the end of the new parts (ITEM #1) as shown in the illustration attached, and install the screws provided (ITEM# 3) for each side.
Note: The table height should not be adjusted higher than 53” (from floor to top of game).
4) Install main and sub leg extention support bracket (ITEM # 2) with the 6 screws provided (ITEM# 3) for each side.
5) Make sure all the screws are tight before putting the cabinet upright.
